from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

from manim import *

class Section1Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup Title and Lecture
        title = Text("Introduction: From Sequential Reading to Global Context", font_size=28).to_edge(UP)
        lecture_lines = [
            "RNNs process text word by word sequentially.",
            "This approach limits understanding of global context.",
            "Transformers read entire sequences simultaneously instead."
        ]
        lecture = VGroup(*[Text(line, font_size=22) for line in lecture_lines])
        lecture.arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8).to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.add(title, lecture)

        # Create elements
        words = VGroup(*[Text("Word", font_size=24, color=YELLOW) for _ in range(3)])
        words.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5).shift(UP * 1.5)
        
        context_box = VGroup(
            Square(side_length=1.5, color=BLUE),
            Text("Context", font_size=20)
        ).shift(DOWN * 0.5)
        
        lines = VGroup(*[Line(start=words[i].get_bottom(), end=context_box.get_top(), color=BLUE) for i in range(3)])

        # Animations
        self.play(FadeIn(lecture[0]), Write(words))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(lecture[1]), Create(lines), FadeIn(context_box))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        glow = Dot(color=WHITE, radius=0.2).move_to(context_box.get_center())
        self.play(
            FadeIn(lecture[2]),
            context_box[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            FadeIn(glow)
        )
        
        self.play(
            lecture[0].animate.set_color(GRAY),
            lecture[1].animate.set_color(GRAY),
            lecture[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW)
        )
        self.wait(2)
